label: Paperless-ngx
agentGuide: Paths end with a slash. Documents: GET /api/documents/?page_size=25&ordering=-created (results[] with id, title, created, correspondent, tags, archive_serial_number); full-text search: GET /api/documents/?query=<words>; filters: &tags__id__in=3&correspondent__id=2&created__year=2026. One document: GET /api/documents/<id>/; its text: field content; its PDF: GET /api/documents/<id>/download/ (binary). Edit: PATCH /api/documents/<id>/ {"title": "...", "tags": [..]}. Tags, correspondents, document types: GET /api/tags/, /api/correspondents/, /api/document_types/. Upload: POST /api/documents/post_document/ (multipart). Counts: GET /api/statistics/.
